note: First-pass depth audit of the external pressure/continuity solve, 2TL/3TL explicit and diffusive momentum, velocity/vertical-viscosity updates, constituent transport/source assembly, and their MPI halo paths. The six previously audited files and the requested physics/output/test exclusions were not selected.

quote:
! *********************************************************************************************
  ! *** CALL THE PRECONDITIONED CONJUGATE GRADIENT SOLVER
  if( num_processors > 1 )then
    if( MDCHH == 0 ) CALL Congrad_MPI    ! *** MSCHH> = 1 not parallelized yet @todo
    TTDS = DSTIME(0)        ! delme - 2TL does not have this communicaiton...
    call MPI_barrier(DSIcomm, ierr)
reason: With MPI and MDCHH>=1, this branch calls neither the MPI pressure solver nor the channel-aware serial solver, then exchanges and uses P as though the continuity system had been solved. The only CONGRADC call is in the serial branch, and no configuration guard neutralizes this path.

quote:
if( num_processors > 1 )then
    if( MDCHH == 0 ) Call Congrad_MPI   ! *** MSCHH> = 1 not parallelized yet @todo
  else
    if( MDCHH == 0 ) CALL CONGRAD
    if( MDCHH >= 1 ) CALL CONGRADC
  endif
reason: The 2TL MPI path likewise performs no pressure/free-surface solve when subgrid channels exist, after which downstream flux and depth updates consume the unsolved P. No MPI channel solver or rejection guard is present on this path.

quote:
if( MDCHTYP(NMD) == 1 )then  
          if( QCHANU(NMD) > 0.0 )then  
            do K = 1,KC  
              QMCSINKX(LCHNU,K) = QMCSINKX(LCHNU,K)-0.5*DZC(L,K)*QCHANU(NMD)*(U(LCHNU,K)+U(LCHNU+1,K))  
              QMCSINKY(LCHNU,K) = QMCSINKY(LCHNU,K)-0.5*DZC(L,K)*QCHANU(NMD)*(V(LCHNU,K)+V(LNC(LCHNU),K))
reason: The channel loop indexes cell-dependent SGZ thickness with L, which is not assigned in this SINGLE block, instead of a channel/host cell such as LCHNU. Thus a stale or undefined unrelated cell controls every layer's channel momentum weight, with no later remapping or guard.

quote:
if( QMCSOURY(L,K) /= 0.0 )then  
            TMPVAL = SVB(L)+SVB(LN)  
            TMPVAL = max(TMPVAL,1.0)  
            FY(L,K)  = FY(L,K)  - SVB3D(L ,K)*QMCSOURX(L,K)/TMPVAL  
            FY(LN,K) = FY(LN,K) - SVB3D(LN,K)*QMCSOURX(L,K)/TMPVAL
reason: The Y-source branch tests QMCSOURY but applies the X component to both FY faces, so the computed Y channel momentum is discarded and X momentum is injected into Y. The SVB masks only scale that wrong component; they do not neutralize it.

quote:
FUHUD(L     , K,IW) = 0.0  
          FUHUD(LEC(L), K,IW) = 0.0  
          FVHUD(L     , K,IW) = 0.0  
          FVHUD(LNC(L), K,IW) = 0.0  
          FWUU(L,K  ,IW)  = 0.0  
          FWVV(L,K-1,IT)  = 0.0
reason: Before positive/negative vertical flux splitting, both adjacent raw antidiffusive faces reside in FWUU, but the lower source-cell face is zeroed in FWVV instead. For an interior source layer FWVV is subsequently regenerated from the still-nonzero FWUU, so the intended source-cell limiter has no neutralizer on that face.

quote:
do LP = LF,LL  
          L = LWET(LP)  
          AQ(L,KSZ(L)) = 0.314*DML(L,KSZ(L))**QQSQR(L,KSZ(L)) + AVOXYHPI(L)
          AQ(L,KC)     = 0.314*DML(L,KC    )* QQSQR(L,KC    ) + AVOXYHPI(L)
        enddo
reason: The bottom AQ expression exponentiates mixing length by sqrt(TKE), while the adjacent interior and top formulas multiply those quantities; this is dimensionally inconsistent and can inflate bottom diffusivity by orders of magnitude. In a multi-active-layer cell the top assignment does not overwrite the bottom value.

quote:
if( ABS(UHDYE(L)) > ABS(VHDXE(L)) )then
                SINH4(L) = 0.25*SINHH/WV(L).FREQ*WV(L).K * SUB(L)*(HP(LWC(L))-HP(L))*DXIU(L)
              else
                SINH4(L) = 0.25*SINHH/WV(L).FREQ*WV(L).K * SUB(L)*(HP(LSC(L))-HP(L))*DYIV(L)
              endif
reason: The south-neighbor depth gradient in the Y-dominant branch is masked by the U-face mask SUB rather than the Y-face mask SVB. At asymmetric walls this admits or suppresses vertical Stokes drift against the actual face geometry, and STOKESW is later added to W2 without an SVB correction.
